error.unexpected: Error banner, shown if something unexpected goes wrong anywhere in the app
error.unknown: Upload log, when a file or entry fails for an unknown reason
error.processFiles: Error banner, when opening files fails unexpectedly
error.export: Error banner, when exporting to Google or LastPass fails unexpectedly
error.cameraProcess: Error banner, when a QR code from the camera can't be processed
error.processingFailed: Upload log, when a camera scan fails
error.noCamera: Error banner, after clicking Scan QR on a device with no camera
error.startCamera: Error banner, when the camera can't start (e.g. permission denied)
error.switchCamera: Error banner, when switching between cameras fails
error.unsupportedFileType: Upload log, when a file isn't an image, JSON, CSV or text file
error.invalidInput: Upload log, when text entered with Enter Code isn't a valid code
error.unsupportedOtpType: Upload log, when a setup link has an unknown type; {type} is the type from the link
error.missingSecret: Upload log, when a setup link has no secret; 'secret' is a technical name, keep it as is
error.missingCounter: Upload log, when a counter-based setup link has no counter; 'counter' and hotp are technical names
error.lastPassMissingContent: Upload log, when a LastPass QR code is damaged; 'content' is a technical name
error.lastPassDecode: Upload log, when a LastPass QR code can't be read
error.lastPassAccounts: Upload log, when a LastPass QR code has no accounts; 'a' is a technical name
error.unsupportedQr: Upload log, when a QR code isn't from Google Authenticator, LastPass or a setup link
error.missingData: Upload log, when a Google export link is damaged; "data" is a technical name
error.payloadParse: Upload log, when a Google export QR code is damaged
error.invalidJson: Upload log, when a JSON file isn't in a format the tool can read
error.imageSecurity: Upload log, when the browser blocks reading an image
error.imageLoad: Upload log, when a file can't be opened as an image
error.textParse: Upload log, when a text file has no valid codes; {detail} is the first problem found, on the next line
error.textLine: Part of the message above; {line} is a line number, {message} the problem on that line
error.invalidFormat: Part of the message above, when a line's problem is unknown
log.cameraScan: Upload log, the name shown for codes scanned with the camera
log.manualInput: Upload log, the name shown for codes typed with Enter Code
log.extracted: Upload log, after secrets are extracted; {count} is how many
log.duplicatesSkipped: Upload log, when some secrets were already in the list; {count} is how many
log.noSecretsInQr: Upload log, when a QR code contains no secrets
log.alreadyProcessed: Upload log, when the same QR code is scanned twice
log.noQrFound: Upload log, when an image has no QR code in it
log.noSecrets: Upload log, when a file or entry contains no secrets
alert.close.error: Read by screen readers: the close button on an error banner
alert.close.warning: Read by screen readers: the close button on a warning banner
alert.close.success: Read by screen readers: the close button on a success banner
alert.close.info: Read by screen readers: the close button on an information banner
export.noSelection: Read by screen readers, when clicking an export button with no accounts selected
export.noData: Read by screen readers, when saving with no accounts in the list
export.noCompatibleLastPass: Error banner, when exporting to LastPass with only counter-based accounts selected
export.scanLastPass: Title above the transfer QR code for LastPass
export.scanGoogle: Title above the transfer QR code for Google Authenticator
export.hotpRemoved: Warning banner, when counter-based accounts are removed from a LastPass export; {count} is how many; "Export to LastPass" is the button name
selection.count: Above the list of accounts; {count} selected out of {total}
results.notAvailable: Account card, shown in place of a missing name or issuer
results.showLargerQr: Read by screen readers: the button on each account's QR code; {title} is the account name
copy.content: Part of the next message: the thing that was copied
copy.copied: Read by screen readers after copying; {subject} is the thing copied
copy.failed: Read by screen readers when copying fails
